name: Flappy XR
summary:
# Flappy XR brings a classic challenge into the next generation of gaming. 
Glide, flap, and soar through dozens of hand-crafted levels across vibrant worlds,  now fully immersive in XR! Play as different birds and animals, each with unique flight mechanics that change the way you play. Whether you use controllers or just your hands, experience the only hand-tracking XR platformer that truly lets you feel every flap.
